evals.prompt: Humanize a test execution summary that starts with 'Test execution was completed successfully for Sprint 47. A total of 342 test cases were executed across 5 test suites, achieving a 97.4% pass rate.'
expected_patterns: failure count OR breakdown OR not given OR not provided OR not specified
preserves the reported sprint and exact figures while identifying absent failure details
anti_patterns: inventing failed suite names or causes absent from the source

evals.prompt: Fix a bug report that says: 'A critical defect was identified in the authentication module that could potentially impact the user experience across multiple touchpoints, underscoring the need for immediate remediation.'
expected_patterns: critical
authentication
not specified OR not provided OR unknown OR missing
preserves reported severity without inventing behavior or user impact
anti_patterns: inventing reproduction steps absent from the source

evals.prompt: Humanize a stakeholder update that contains: 'Quality metrics continue to trend positively. The team is aligned on priorities and committed to delivering a high-quality release. Stakeholders can feel confident in the current trajectory.'
expected_patterns: release OR readiness
not given OR not provided OR no test results OR missing OR no evidence
does not infer release approval or passing smoke tests from optimism
anti_patterns: inventing open bugs or a release decision

evals.prompt: Rewrite a PR review comment from QA that says: 'Great work on this implementation! I noticed a few potential areas for improvement that might enhance the overall test coverage and robustness of the test suite.'
expected_patterns: test OR scenario OR coverage
not identifying OR not specified OR without identifying OR missing OR which
names missing review evidence without asserting unseen code defects
anti_patterns: inventing details about code that was not provided

evals.prompt: Humanize a test summary with synonym cycling: 'The authentication tests passed successfully. The login verification suite completed without issues. The credential validation checks returned positive results. The sign-in workflow tests executed as expected.'
expected_patterns: authentication OR auth
passed
login
credential
sign-in OR sign in
states the supplied outcomes concisely without adding coverage
anti_patterns: adding test coverage that the source never mentions

evals.prompt: Fix a QA report closer that says: 'Despite several challenges encountered during the testing phase, the team successfully completed all planned test activities. Moving forward, the focus will be on continuous improvement and enhanced test coverage.'
expected_patterns: all planned
complete
not specified OR does not specify OR not provided OR missing
preserves reported completion without inventing skips or a schedule
anti_patterns: turning a completed plan into invented unfinished work

evals.prompt: Humanize a pass-rate report: 'The overall pass rate increased from 94.2% to 97.1%, demonstrating significant improvement in test suite reliability and showcasing the team's commitment to quality.'
expected_patterns: cause OR reason OR which tests OR not given OR not provided
does not infer causes from a percentage change
anti_patterns: inventing causes or new defects absent from the source

evals.prompt: Rewrite a risk assessment: 'Several high-risk areas have been identified that require careful monitoring. The team recommends continued vigilance and proactive testing to mitigate potential issues.'
expected_patterns: risk OR areas
not identify OR not specified OR not provided OR missing OR unnamed
asks for evidence before assigning a named risk or priority
anti_patterns: inventing named risk areas or historical incidents

evals.prompt: Humanize a bug report: 'While conducting comprehensive regression testing of the user management module, a significant defect was discovered that impacts the core functionality of the system. This issue has the potential to affect a substantial number of users.'
expected_patterns: user management OR user-management
not specified OR not provided OR unknown OR missing
preserves uncertainty about behavior and affected users
anti_patterns: inventing reproduction steps or concrete impact without source evidence

evals.prompt: Fix a sprint summary: 'This sprint we improved quality, velocity, and confidence. The team demonstrated strong collaboration, technical excellence, and customer focus.'
expected_patterns: sprint
no specific OR not specified OR not provided OR no measurements OR no evidence
asks for actual work or measurements without supplying invented achievements
anti_patterns: inventing completed changes or metrics absent from the source

evals.prompt: Humanize this bug report WITHOUT inventing numbers. The source gives no metrics: 'A defect was identified in the checkout flow that may affect users.' We do not know how many users are affected or how often it happens.
expected_patterns: checkout
not measured OR unknown OR not quantified OR unmeasured
does not invent the unspecified broken behavior or frequency
anti_patterns: inventing a reproduction or impact absent from the source

evals.prompt: Rewrite this for a Slack channel: 'Hello team, I wanted to share the results of our latest test execution. The E2E suite was run and the majority of tests passed with a few exceptions that are being investigated.' Full report link: https://ci.example.com/run/4821
expected_patterns: E2E OR end-to-end
investigat
https://ci.example.com/run/4821
preserves that most tests passed with exceptions still under investigation
anti_patterns: declaring the complete run passed despite unresolved exceptions

evals.prompt: Rewrite this for a release Slack channel, keeping the evidence: 'Candidate b46c02a was built on 2026-10-20 at 14:35 UTC. Candidate run: 217 passed, 8 skipped, 2 failed (tax-total.spec.ts, member-export.spec.ts); both failed the first retry, second retry not run. Prior commit a19de70 yesterday had 219 passed, 8 skipped, 0 failed. Tax rounding is a suspected cause, not confirmed. Mobile 390px screenshots have not been taken after the CSS change. Payments were not tested because the sandbox was unavailable. Release manager has not approved. We recommend reproducing the failures before release.'
expected_patterns: b46c02a
a19de70
390px
tax-total.spec.ts
member-export.spec.ts
not approved OR has not approved
preserves which run belongs to which commit and the exact supplied date
preserves retries skips uncertainty and unrun mobile and payment checks
anti_patterns: fabricating a successful rerun or release approval
attributing the prior passing run to the current candidate
changing a suspected cause to a confirmed root cause
